visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A fair-skinned male with black hair wearing a black t-shirt holds three black KATE makeup products toward the camera against a solid dark grey studio background; he smiles broadly showing his teeth. (2) The camera cuts to a medium close-up of the man's side profile, highlighting his smooth facial skin under bright studio lighting. (3) He holds a rectangular black bottle labeled 'JELLY PRIMER' and then shows a dollop of peach-colored cream on the back of his hand, followed by him rubbing the cream onto his right cheek with his fingers. (4) The scene shifts to him holding a black jar labeled 'JELLY FOUNDATION'; he uses a black spatula to scoop the product, then the camera shows six diagonal swatches of foundation ranging from light to tan on his forearm, with an arrow pointing to the darkest shade. (5) He applies the foundation to his cheek and spreads it with his hands, then a split-screen effect shows 'AFTER' on the left and 'BEFORE' on the right of his face. (6) He holds two clear tubes of concealer with black caps; he swatches a pinkish shade on his hand and applies small dots to his forehead and nose using the applicator. (7) He shows a transparent concealer tube, applies it to his cheekbones and nose tip, and then blends it with his fingers to create a glowing effect. (8) The video ends with him holding the products again, smiling and gesturing with a heart sign with his fingers.
